solutions.title: Recursive remaining sum
solutions.strategy: Subtract node values on descent and test the remaining sum at leaves.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node is visited once until a matching path is found.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion stack grows with tree height h.

solutions.title: Iterative node sums
solutions.strategy: Carry each node with the sum accumulated to that node.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node is pushed and popped at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The explicit stack follows pending root-to-node paths and is height-sized for skewed trees.
